acceptance_predicates.description: Every manifest route has tested concise human default output for applicable success and failure journeys.
Machine JSON is emitted only for explicit JSON mode and remains schema-compatible and human-output silent.
Failures name a concrete cause and usable next action without private data.

definition_of_done: All route transcript tests and normal ASB quality gates pass on the independently reviewed exact head.

outputs.description: Mechanical human/default/JSON transcript coverage for all public routes.

gates.description: Human, JSON, quiet, and error output contracts pass for every route.
